Music & credits

Composition: Edvard Grieg, In the Hall of the Mountain King, from Peer Gynt. The composition is in the public domain in the United States and countries with a standard life-plus-70-year term.

This film uses a newly synthesized recording and original procedural 3D animation. No filmed footage or third-party recordings were used. The original generated recording and animation are supplied under CC0 to the extent rights may be waived.
